settings.meta_description: Straightforward support with workplace grievances, disciplinaries, investigations and employment-related concerns.

hero.description: Clear, practical support when workplace issues become difficult. Understand the process, prepare for what comes next and make informed decisions with confidence.
hero.image_alt: A professional workplace consultation in a warm, private office

services.heading: Support for complex workplace matters.
services.description: When work becomes complicated, you deserve explanations you can understand and practical support you can act on.

cards.title: Grievances
cards.description: Support with raising or responding to workplace grievances, organising your evidence and preparing your next steps.

cards.title: Disciplinaries & Appeals
cards.description: Understand the process, prepare for formal meetings and approach disciplinary outcomes or appeals with clarity.

cards.title: Workplace Investigations
cards.description: Guidance on investigation meetings, allegations, evidence and the procedures you may be facing at work.

highlights.title: Practical next steps
highlights.description: Know your options before making decisions.

about.heading: Clear explanations. Support that makes sense.
about.description: Afaz Explains helps people navigate difficult workplace situations with practical, straightforward guidance. Whether you're preparing for a meeting, reviewing correspondence or considering your options, the aim is to help you feel informed and ready for the next step.
about.image_alt: A calm, private meeting room with dark navy interiors

statement.heading: Clarity makes a difference.
statement.quote: You should be able to understand what's happening at work, what your options are and how to prepare for what comes next.

contact.heading: Let's make your situation clearer.
contact.description: Whether you need a one-off consultation or more involved support, get in touch to discuss how Afaz Explains may be able to help.

footer.contact_description: Questions about a workplace issue? Start a conversation.
